answer.summary: Resets the account's cycle-specific financial counters to zero and initializes the minimum amount field to the system minimum value. This prepares the account record for a new billing or settlement cycle.

rules.text: Sets the cycle debit balance (KTO_ZYK_SOL) to 0.
Sets the cycle credit balance (KTO_ZYK_HAB) to 0.
Sets the cycle payment count (KTO_ZYK_ZAHL) to 0.
Sets the minimum amount (KTO_MINZ) to the system minimum value (§MIN).
